author: (Suhr ex J.Agardh) Díaz-Tapia & Maggs, 2017

note.en: A fine, dark red weed of the Polysiphonia type that grows on seaweeds and seagrass and is recorded in the region box as Neosiphonia ferulacea.
note.es: Un alga roja fina y oscura del tipo Polysiphonia que crece sobre algas y pasto marino y está registrada en la zona como Neosiphonia ferulacea.

evidence: GBIF record in the region box under the old name Neosiphonia ferulacea

sources.t: GBIF herbarium specimen records inside the region box (Gandoca to Limón)
